description: Golden retrieval-evaluation set for backend/scripts/evaluate_retrieval.py (Phase 5, MLOps governance harness). Each query is a real, human-written question against the content of one of this repo's standing fixture contracts (data/*.pdf, already used across the Playwright suite - see frontend/e2e/hitl-workflow.spec.ts's Clean_MSA.pdf comment). expected_filenames is the ground truth for Recall@K/nDCG@K, scored against POST /contracts/search/enhanced's document-level ranking for the same tenant these fixtures were ingested into.

queries.query: Which contract makes the company's liability unlimited and requires it to indemnify the client even for the client's own negligence?
Find the services agreement where payment is due within ninety days and is subject to the client's sole discretion.
Find the mutual non-disclosure agreement between two parties evaluating a potential business relationship.
Which agreement is between AlphaVentures and BetaConsulting about protecting confidential business and technical information?
Which document is the statement of work for a cloud migration and modernization project?
Find the statement of work with a fixed fee of $150,000 covering an architecture blueprint and deployment scripts.
What is our internal policy position on acceptable indemnification terms for vendor contracts?
What is the standard enterprise cap on liability expressed as a multiple of annual contract value?
Show me the Salesforce master subscription agreement covering purchased services and order forms.
Which agreement grants Salesforce a license to host and transmit customer data and covers mutual indemnification for patent infringement claims?
